Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
simm...@ucbeh.san.uc.edu wrote:

: My question is: In combat can a vampire abstain from a strike. Or to put it in

: clearer terms: does a vampire have to hit the other vampire he or she is
: fighting. Can they abstain from taking any action at all in combat?

A vampire cannot choose to abstain from striking a foe in combat; they
must choose a strike, even if it is an obviously useless one (i.e. hands
when combat is at long range, dodge when opponent has already dodged.)

: Also, is there another newsgroup created for "Vampire:tes" or is going to

: remain the main forum for Jyhad and Vampire?

There was a brief flurry of discussion about changing the name, and then
the topic died down completely. It seemed to be the consensus that nobody
wants to go through the hassle of creating the new group and rmgrouping
this one for what is essentially a marketing move on the part of WotC.
